answer: Lock each identity's stake in a glacier vault: 160 POA frozen 90 days, thawing 10% monthly only after verified work. Each identity carries a pigment fingerprint, a hash of work history and device keys, checked against prior fingerprints. New agents need one saffron seal, a rare attestation capped at three per epoch. A second identity locks 320 POA, thaws over 180 days and needs two seals, a third 640 POA and four, so capital, delay and scarcity double per fake. Auditors verify locks, fingerprints and seals on-ledger, slashing 35% of linked stakes for duplicated work.
